guide.title: Launch your first ad in 5 steps
guide.text: Upload a 7-second video, choose a plan, stores and shelf zones, set a budget — and shoppers will see your ad on cart screens.

facts.payment: Pay by card, Kaspi QR or invoice
facts.review: We review the video before launch

steps.title: How to create a campaign
steps.lead: The wizard guides you step by step. Here is what you need at each step.

video.title: Video and details
video.text: Name, description, a 7-second video and a cover. Without a cover we use the first frame of the video.

tariff.title: Plan
tariff.text: The plan decides where the video plays and the campaign's minimum budget.

stores.title: Stores
stores.text: Mark supermarkets on the map or in the list — by city and chain.

zones.title: Shelf zones
zones.text: The video starts when a shopper approaches the selected shelf.

budget.title: Budget and payment
budget.text: The budget must be at least the plan minimum. Pay by card, Kaspi QR or invoice.

after.title: After payment
after.startText: On carts in the selected stores

tariffs.title: Plans
tariffs.lead: The plan defines where the video is shown and the minimum campaign budget. The higher the plan, the more options and the higher the minimum.

standard.name: Standard
standard.text: The video plays in the general rotation on all carts of the selected stores.

zones.name: Standard + Zones
zones.text: Plus priority at the selected shelves: only zone-plan videos play in the zone.

premium.name: Premium
premium.text: Zones and more impressions: the video plays more often both in rotation and at the shelves.

exclusive.name: Exclusive
exclusive.text: Only your brand in the selected zones — no other advertisers.

feature.allCarts: All carts of the selected stores
feature.brandOnly: Only your brand in the zone

tariffs.note: The minimum budget is the amount a campaign can start with. You can top up the budget at any time.

budget.title: How the budget works

own.title: Each campaign has its own budget
own.text: Money of one campaign is not spent on another. A new campaign needs a new budget.

minimum.title: The minimum depends on the plan
minimum.text: A campaign starts when its budget is at least the plan minimum.

spending.title: Impressions are charged to the budget
spending.text: When the budget runs out, impressions stop. Top it up in the campaign card and they continue.

budget.hint: {pct}% left — top up so impressions don't stop

sections.title: Account sections
sections.campaigns: All campaigns with their statuses and budgets. Create campaigns and top up budgets here.
sections.stats: Impressions and spend by day, store and zone. Export the report to Excel.
sections.analytics: Compare campaigns, stores and zones: see what works better.
sections.profile: Company details, billing details and contacts.

format.q: What should the ad be like?
format.a: The video is 7 seconds long. We show the file format and size requirements on upload and review the video before launch.

start.a: After payment and the video review — from the start date you choose. The review result comes by email.

impression.a: A video that played to the end on a cart screen. Statistics count only full impressions.

budgetEnd.q: What happens when the budget runs out?
budgetEnd.a: Impressions stop, and the campaign is kept. Top up the budget and impressions continue.

payment.a: By card, Kaspi QR or invoice for companies. With an invoice, the campaign starts once the payment arrives.

support.titleFirst: We'll help with your first launch
support.title: Need help with a campaign?
support.text: A manager will answer questions about plans, stores and payment.

lowBudget.text: {amount} left. Top up so impressions don't stop.
